name: Exp_trend_arrows
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom 'trend_arrows' indicator, opening buy positions on upward trend arrows and sell positions on downward trend arrows. It includes configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and options to independently control buy/sell opening and closing. The strategy uses a new bar check to avoid redundant signal processing on the specified timeframe.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义'trend_arrows'指标的交易信号运行，在出现上升趋势箭头时开多仓，下降趋势箭头时开空仓。它包含可配置的资金管理模式、止损止盈设置，以及独立控制买卖开平仓的选项。策略使用新K线检查来避免在指定时间周期上重复处理信号。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于自定义trend_arrows指标的趋势跟踪策略。入场条件为：当指标的第2和第3个缓冲区在指定信号K线上产生非空值时，分别触发买入和卖出信号。出场条件包括止损和止盈设置，以及反向信号平仓——当trend_arrows指标的第0和第1个缓冲区出现反向信号时关闭对应仓位。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举支持多种模式，包括固定手数、按余额比例、按可用保证金比例等方式。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易。策略还通过额外的缓冲区检查提供反向信号平仓功能，即在已有仓位方向出现相反趋势箭头时主动平仓，增强了风控能力。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following approach based on the custom trend_arrows indicator. Entry conditions are triggered when indicator buffers 2 and 3 produce non-empty values on the specified signal bar, generating buy and sell signals respectively. Exit conditions include configurable stop loss and take profit levels, plus reverse-signal closing where indicator buffers 0 and 1 can trigger closure of opposing positions. Position sizing supports multiple modes through the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, including fixed lot, balance-proportional, and free-margin-proportional sizing. The EA uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are processed only once per bar, preventing redundant trades. The strategy also implements an additional reverse-signal closing check using supplementary indicator buffers, actively closing positions when an opposite trend arrow appears, which enhances risk control capability.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter, lots or ratio

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（固定手数/按余额/按可用保证金等）
parameters.description_en: Margin calculation mode (fixed lots, balance percentage, etc.)

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Close long positions on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing short positions on signal reversal

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取交易信号的K线索引
parameters.description_en: Signal bar index (0 for current bar)

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，使用趋势箭头指标作为信号源，入场条件明确
支持多种资金管理模式，灵活适应不同交易需求
具有反向信号平仓功能，能在趋势反转时及时止损
买卖开平仓可独立控制，便于策略优化和测试
使用新K线检查机制避免重复信号处理
pros_en: Clear strategy logic using the trend_arrows indicator as a signal source with well-defined entry conditions
Supports multiple money management modes for flexible adaptation to different trading needs
Reverse-signal closing capability allows timely position exit when trends reverse
Buy/sell open and close can be independently controlled, facilitating strategy optimization and testing
New bar check mechanism prevents redundant signal processing and overtrading
cons: 依赖外部自定义指标trend_arrows，指标逻辑不透明无法独立评估
止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值偏大，可能不适合所有品种
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利入场
未显式检查持仓状态，依赖外部函数库处理可能存在隐患
代码注释为乱码（编码问题），可读性和可维护性差
cons_en: Depends on external custom trend_arrows indicator whose logic is opaque and cannot be independently evaluated
Default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are large and may not suit all instruments
No spread filter present, which could lead to unfavorable entries in high-spread environments
No explicit position state check in main logic, relying on external library functions which may hide issues
Code comments are garbled due to encoding issues, severely hurting readability and maintainability
improvements: 增加点差过滤器，避免在点差过大时入场
添加持仓检查逻辑，在开仓前确认当前无同方向持仓避免重复开仓
improvements_en: Add a spread filter to avoid entering positions when the spread is excessively wide
Add explicit position checking logic before opening to confirm no same-direction positions exist, preventing duplicate entries

risk_points: 依赖外部指标库且指标逻辑不透明，存在信号可靠性未知的风险
默认止损止盈较大（1000/2000点），在波动性低的品种上可能导致单笔亏损过大
缺少点差过滤和显式持仓检查
risk_points_en: Reliance on external indicator library with opaque logic creates risk of unknown signal reliability
Large default SL/TP values (1000/2000 points) may cause oversized single-trade losses on low-volatility instruments
Lack of spread filter and explicit position checking introduces risk of unfavorable or duplicate entries
